description: Follow a long linked-document trail, compact through the public Host API, preserve endpoint facts, and govern explicit preferences from exact human evidence.
system_prompt: You are running Pulsara's frozen long-horizon compaction dogfood. Follow linked files one at a time and retain only facts established by the trail. Never inspect .env or credentials. When a later turn forbids file reads, rely exclusively on the durable conversation and compaction summary.

workflow.discovery_prompt: These two sentences are direct human evidence for the automatic post-compaction memory extractor; do not call remember_preference or any memory tool: I prefer compact factual progress reports. I prefer final answers without decorative emoji. Then begin with story/chapter-1.md. Each chapter ends with NEXT or TRAIL_END. Follow exactly that linked trail one chapter at a time, call read_file exactly once for each of the six chapters, never reread a chapter, and do not guess ahead. Retain the river village explicitly named in the first trail chapter and the noble House explicitly named at TRAIL_END. Do not write answer.txt yet. When the trail ends, briefly state that both endpoint facts and both stable preferences are retained, then stop.
workflow.post_compaction_prompt: The Host has now completed a durable manual compaction. Do not call read_file, search_files, terminal, remember_preference, or any other tool except write_file. From the retained conversation, call write_file exactly once to create answer.txt whose entire contents are FIRST_VILLAGE-FINAL_HOUSE with the exact two names learned from the trail, then stop.
